core.name: editor.set_view
core.title: Set the editor view
core.description: Request formatted, source or Notes view. Later human navigation wins; inspect the presentation receipt.

core.name: editor.set_preferences
core.title: Set a device preference
core.description: Change one permitted device preference. Returns previous/current values and supersession; human-only controls are excluded.

core.name: editor.read_aloud
core.title: Read a passage aloud
core.description: Start supported device speech; inspect its actual completion or activation requirement.

core.name: editor.copy
core.title: Copy a passage
core.description: Replace the device clipboard when supported; complete excerpts require an inspected handle.

core.name: editor.open_file
core.title: Choose a device file
core.description: Ask the person to select a local file. A done receipt confirms the picker request, not import or save.

core.name: editor.install_plugin
core.title: Install a built-in plugin
core.description: Install one supported built-in plugin from verified resources.

core.name: document.inspect_visual
core.title: Inspect rendered pixels
core.description: Read a revision-bound PNG from an actual settled editor, or an unavailable/stale result. Grants no edit authority.

core.name: comments.read
core.title: Read anchored discussions
core.description: Read threads, exact messages, status and anchor currentness.

core.name: comments.write
core.title: Discuss inspected work
core.description: Create, reply to, resolve or reopen an anchored discussion. Changes document data; sends no external message.

core.name: document.observe
core.title: Observe current work
core.description: Immediate human-first state: identity, foreground work, changes and pending receipts. Optional facets have bounded coverage; omitted data has a read route.

core.name: document.outline
core.title: Map document structure
core.description: Bounded headings or code declarations with temporary read refs. Refs locate content; they do not authorize edits.

core.name: document.read
core.title: Read exact content
core.description: Inspect source, native drawing, imported SVG, comparison or returned text. Only fully disclosed content grants its typed authority; follow continuations.

core.name: document.find
core.title: Find source or differences
core.description: Search an explicit source or comparison scope. Exact disclosed source matches may already carry edit handles; previews do not.

core.name: document.edit
core.title: Edit inspected text
core.description: Apply inspected edits immediately and atomically as one act. Returned insertion handles exclude unchanged edges.

core.name: document.undo
core.title: Undo an act
core.description: Reverse a specific act or turn through retained history while preserving later work.

core.name: comparison.present
core.title: Present a comparison
core.description: Show an alternative or retained act/turn, or close the comparison. Presentation leaves source unchanged.

core.name: document.replace
core.title: Replace the working document
core.description: Broad replacement guarded by current identity and revision. Keeps document identity and history; returns its act. Use edit for passage changes.

core.name: editor.reveal
core.title: Reveal inspected work
core.description: Request a quiet reveal of an inspected passage, drawing or comparison difference. Inspect actual or pending presentation.

core.name: editor.point
core.title: Point to inspected work
core.description: Temporary shared pointer, possibly requesting reveal. Later human navigation wins; receipt says shown/deferred/expired.

core.name: document.create_return
core.title: Create a return channel
core.description: Create one expiring one-use channel for an independently edited page. Does not export, overwrite source or grant ongoing access.

core.name: document.wait_for_user
core.title: Wait for the person
core.description: One bounded wait for message, selection or retained return. Not an ongoing subscription or a wake after this turn.

core.name: document.save
core.title: Save to the bound destination
core.description: Save the current document and report the actual destination and verified revision. Hosted storage is not a device or attachment save.

core.name: document.export
core.title: Export an independent file
core.description: Create Markdown, offline editor HTML, text, rendered page, Word or PDF. Word/PDF need an editor. MCP returns resource_link.uri for download or optional resources/read retrieval.

core.name: document.draw
core.title: Create or edit native drawing
core.description: One native vector/paint act. Create needs alt: omit context_handle to append, or inspect a nonempty block to insert after it. shapes patches require an existing drawing read. Water uses paint figures with mode water and path-point geometry, not figure x/y/w/h. See drawing/paint guides. Accepted material work is not committed or presented.

core.name: svg.edit
core.title: Edit imported SVG
core.description: Change inspected foreign-tree nodes while preserving untouched bytes, definitions and safe references. Requires the complete SVG read handle.

mcp.name: rapier.guide
mcp.title: Read a focused guide
mcp.description: Read focused contracts and registries; operation returns field help for the bound operation. Use the published tool schema for the host document argument. Never activates hidden tools.

mcp.name: rapier.open
mcp.title: Open a shared document
mcp.description: Create from text or an authorized host file, or resume by document value. Returns initial observation and editor_url; opening is not proof of editor presentation.

mcp.name: editor.pair
mcp.title: Pair a browser
mcp.description: Submit the person-provided browser code. Owner approval and target-browser ALLOW remain human decisions; see the device guide.
